mainEntity.name: What are B2B stablecoin payments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payments between businesses that use stablecoins such as USDC or USDT to move value, often converted to local currency at either end.

mainEntity.name: Are B2B stablecoin payments legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rules vary by country. Work with a provider that verifies businesses and operates with licensed partners in the markets you pay.

mainEntity.name: Does the supplier need to accept crypto?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The supplier can receive local currency in a bank account or mobile money wallet.

acceptedAnswer.text: A service that lets a business accept payments from customers in African markets, usually by mobile money, bank transfer and cards, and settle the funds.

mainEntity.name: Which payment methods matter most in Africa?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the country. Mobile money dominates in East and West Africa; bank transfer is central in Nigeria and South Africa.

acceptedAnswer.text: Some gateways allow it. ElementPay settles into local currency, USD, USDC or USDT.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between USDC and USDT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are US dollar stablecoins. USDC is issued by Circle and USDT by Tether. They differ in issuer, reserve reporting and how widely each is used on different networks.

mainEntity.name: Which stablecoin is used more in Africa?

acceptedAnswer.text: USDT is widely used in peer-to-peer and trading markets; USDC is common with regulated fintechs and global platforms. Many businesses accept both.

mainEntity.name: Can ElementPay pay out from both?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ElementPay supports funding and off-ramps from USDC and USDT.

mainEntity.name: How do we open an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sign up and complete business verification. Once approved, fund your balance in fiat or stablecoins and start paying and collecting.

mainEntity.name: Which countries can we pay out to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cameroon, DR Congo, South Africa, Zambia, Malawi, Mozambique and Botswana.

mainEntity.name: How fast do payments arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most mobile money payouts are sent on local rails as soon as you confirm, with a status for every payment.

mainEntity.name: Which currencies can we hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bank accounts are issued one per currency, in USD, EUR, GBP, ZAR, CAD, AED, NGN, GHS, KES, TZS, AUD, NZD, JPY, CNY, HKD, ILS, MXN, SEK, CHF, NOK, DKK, SGD, KRW, THB, HUF, PLN, RON, CZK, XOF and XAF.

mainEntity.name: Can we fund payouts with USDC or USDT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Hold USDC or USDT in your ElementPay balance and use it as the source for any payout. We convert to local currency at a rate shown upfront.

mainEntity.name: Is ElementPay a bank?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. ElementPay is a financial technology company. Banking services are provided by licensed partner institutions.
